extraction_notes: AO4459 is a p-channel MOSFET. Datasheet voltages and currents are quoted with negative polarity; all curve coordinates and scalar fit inputs are stored as positive magnitudes, with the original polarity preserved in conditions.
Threshold voltage is -1.4 V minimum, -1.9 V typical, and -2.4 V maximum at VDS = VGS and ID = -250 microA; threshold scalar values are stored as magnitudes.

RDS(on) is 33 mOhm typical and 46 mOhm maximum at VGS = -10 V, ID = -6.5 A; 50 mOhm typical and 68 mOhm maximum at TJ = 125 degC for the same bias; and 53 mOhm typical and 72 mOhm maximum at VGS = -4.5 V, ID = -5 A. The strict schema stores the typical values and preserves maxima in this note.
Ciss = 520 pF, Coss = 100 pF, and Crss = 65 pF typical at VGS = 0 V, VDS = -15 V, f = 1 MHz. The capacitance plot is retained as three digitized traces in SI units.
BVDSS is -30 V minimum at ID = -250 microA, VGS = 0 V; the scalar breakdown voltage is stored as 30 V magnitude.

The body-diode row gives VSD = -0.8 V typical and -1.0 V maximum at IS = -1 A, VGS = 0 V; the scalar body-diode value stores the typical 0.8 V magnitude. Body-diode reverse recovery is 11 ns typical at IF = -6.5 A and di/dt = 100 A/us, and Qrr is 5.3 nC; these have no dedicated schema fields.

Thermal table values are RthetaJA = 31 degC/W typical and 40 degC/W maximum for t <= 10 s, 59/75 degC/W steady-state, and RthetaJL = 16/24 degC/W; thermal fields are not represented in the strict schema.
The p. 3 curves are based on pulses below 300 us and duty cycle 0.5% maximum per note E.
